label: Wed, Sep 30
title: Sep 30 Daily Summary
speech:
Oh, I have been waiting all day to give this speech. All. Day.

We played 4 today. 4 wins, 0 draws, 0 losses. We put 14 in the back of the net and let 4 into ours.

When it clicked, it really clicked. Look at the 4-0 over Gerth United. That's who we can be. Every time they thought they had an answer, you asked a new question. That's what good teams do, and tonight you were a good team. Heck, you were a great one.

What I saw today was a team that trusts each other. You played for the person next to you, and that's the whole secret. That's it. That's the speech. Well, no, I've got more.

BellyTb1, 7 goals across 4 games and an 8.2 average. That's the kind of day that makes a coach misty. tuxedo_slide: 5 goals, 2 assists, 5 key passes, 8.0 average. You were the steady heartbeat of this team today. And PhogsToffees, 2 goals, 6 assists, 7 key passes and an 8.0 average over 4 games. Don't you dare let anybody tell you that didn't matter.

And can we talk about PhogsToffees and BellyTb1? 9 goals between 'em. If that partnership were a band, I'd buy the t-shirt.

I once saw a kid at a county fair win the ring toss five times in a row, and the whole crowd just started chanting his name. That's how I felt watching you tonight. I was the crowd. I was chanting.

Homework, and yes, I'm assigning homework: forcing passes. Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

Now, I'm not gonna tell you to come back down to earth. You can float a little tonight. You earned the altitude.

I'm so proud of you I could burst like a water balloon at a church picnic. Enjoy it tonight. Every single one of you earned it.
key_stats: Player of the day: BellyTb1 (8.2 avg, 7 goals, 0 assists)
